name: K-C Logan Township Distribution Center - Logan Township NJ

fieldNotes.location: Roster coordinates (39.747335, -75.310914) were wrong - they fell in the Bridgeport residential village ~9 km NE of the site. The K-C Logan Township DC is documented by its general contractor (Blue Rock Construction) as 'Building GHI at LogistiCenter at Logan', 2651 Oldmans Creek Rd, Logan Township NJ - a 599,500 sq ft, LEED-certified 2007 Dermody Properties build. Locked the large single-tenant white-roofed warehouse at ~39.7385,-75.4135 inside the LogistiCenter at Logan / Logan North logistics park, off I-295.
fieldNotes.tenancy: Multiple sources indicate Amazon later leased ~1M sq ft at 2651 Oldmans Creek Rd (Amazon FC 'TEB3'). The building audited here is that DC structure regardless of current tenant - it is the facility the roster targets.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate or guard booth visible at the property line in any satellite or Street View imagery (Street View 2019 and 2026-04). The building fronts a public road with open driveways and only employee-parking landscaping out front. A blue 'TRUCK ENTRANCE' directional sign marks the truck route but the entrance itself is uncontrolled. Set truckGate false; guardShack false; remoteGs false. Low confidence - a manned booth could exist deeper in the yard out of Street View reach.
fieldNotes.docks: Dock doors run nearly continuously along BOTH long faces (east and west) of the ~450-510m building, with trailers backed in along each. Total well into the 50+ band; dockDoorCount ~110 is an honest overhead estimate (loose).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: True - dock banks on two physically separate (opposite) building faces, consistent with split shipping/receiving.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lanes south of the building and along the east yard, full of parked trailers without tractors - dropArea 50+.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved truck approach from the public road into the dock yard, easily 3+ trucks of stacking room. postGateStaging true (paved holding room inside the property before the docks).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved yard aprons and a generous gate apron leave ample room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Class-A logistics park (LogistiCenter at Logan) surrounded by farmland and other big-box warehouses on the rural SW edge of Gloucester County - edge-of-town industrial. Per rubric, classified Rural.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~101 acres derived from the perimeter box; the building footprint alone is roughly 600k-1M sq ft.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: 1 - the single DC structure. Other warehouses nearby are separate properties, not part of this campus.
